name: player_update_third_person_camera
description: Player::UpdateThirdPersonCamera derives the third-person camera target from world position plus lerp offset, updates the main camera and horizon node, computes camera pitch/yaw toward the player look-at point, and refreshes normalized camera direction vectors.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this camera helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x405650 validates the camera target, horizon Object3D position update, Vec3DirectionAnglesBetweenPoints call, camera position setter, and normalized cameraDir/cameraDirFlat writes.
The native smoke checks a representative camera target, horizon position, camera pitch/yaw, and normalized direction outputs.
